route_title: Reduced perturbation initialization with weighted 400-550 nm spectral loss
compilation_rationale: Topology override restricts stack to exactly 12 finite layers (6 HfO2/SiO2 pairs). Initial thicknesses mapped from the first 12 values of the provided vector, bounded by ±10 nm. Weighted reflectance requirement split into two sub-band targets with relative weights 2.0 and 1.0. Coherent TMM with smatrix solver evaluates performance across the specified spectral windows.
